criteria.requirement: Build on delivered prefix cloning and add Bottle.inspect_routes() returning stable registration-order JSON metadata for actual rule/method/name/current-or-external owner, safe callback name, dynamic filter names and route-specific plugin names. Correctly explain legacy external owners and prefixed target-owned clones. Introspection must never execute callbacks, apply plugins, expose configuration/closure values or use address-bearing repr. Handle callable instances and unnamed/empty routes while preserving registration and dispatch.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
